overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: three members' brief social conversation was below a quorum, and the later 30-second presence of a quorum involved no Commission business, so no meeting or deliberation occurred.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Commission failed to post notice for and allow public access to an October 20, 2010 gathering of its members.
allegations.key_passage: Because this was less than a quorum of the seven member body, and the conversation did not involve matters within the body's jurisdiction, their discussion did not constitute a deliberation.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
